definitions.explanation: Two children born at the same birth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{双子|ふたご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: She is a mother of twins.

examples.japanese: {双子|ふたご}⟦なのに→なのに：22395_nanoni⟧⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧⟦{似|に}て→似る：01159_niru⟧⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Even though they're twins, they don't look alike at all.

examples.japanese: {双子|ふたご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姉妹|しまい}→姉妹：03201_shimai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are twin sisters in the class.

examples.japanese: {双子|ふたご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦だが→だが：00031_daga⟧、⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んで→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{助|たす}かる→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧。
examples.english: Raising twins is hard, but it helps that they play together.

examples.japanese: {双子|ふたご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦そっくり→そっくり：00378_sokkuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦でさえ→でさえ：noentry⟧⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The twin brothers look so alike that even their teacher sometimes mistakes one for the other.

notes:
{双子|ふたご} is the everyday word for twins. Formed from ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧ + ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧.

TYPES:
- ⟦{一卵性|いちらんせい}→一卵性：08959_ichiransei⟧⟦{双生児|そうせいじ}→双生児：28185_souseiji⟧: identical twins
- ⟦{二卵性|にらんせい}→二卵性：noentry⟧⟦{双生児|そうせいじ}→双生児：28185_souseiji⟧: fraternal twins

Note: ⟦{双生児|そうせいじ}→双生児：28185_souseiji⟧ is the formal/medical term for twins.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {双子|ふたご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧: twin brothers/siblings
- {双子|ふたご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姉妹|しまい}→姉妹：03201_shimai⟧: twin sisters
- {双子|ふたご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to raise twins

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{三つ子|みつご}→三つ子：28184_mitsugo⟧: triplets
- ⟦{四つ子|よつご}→四つ子：28217_yotsugo⟧: quadruplets
- ⟦{双子座|ふたござ}→双子座：29555_futagoza⟧: Gemini (zodiac sign)

PROVERB:
⟦{三つ子|みつご}→三つ子：28184_mitsugo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魂|たましい}→魂：14639_tamashii⟧⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ — "The character formed by age three lasts to a hundred" (here ⟦{三つ子|みつご}→三つ子：28184_mitsugo⟧ means "a three-year-old," not "triplets").
